items.body: Cloud Solutions Architect — Design the full infrastructure before a single server is provisioned. You translate business goals into VPCs, subnets, and service boundaries that every other team depends on.
DevOps Engineer — Own the pipeline from the moment code is committed to the moment it runs in production. CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies are your daily vocabulary.
Cloud Security Engineer — Every company needs someone to lock the doors. You design IAM policies, set guardrails, and make sure no port is left open to the internet by accident.
Site Reliability Engineer — Keep the lights on when traffic spikes at 2 a.m. You write the runbooks, set the SLOs, and own the pager when something goes wrong at scale.
